fields.statement: Verifier of fix attempt 3 at 544cb11 (cycle 2's confirmed model f1: two leaf fixers live at once after a verifier retry). Read the diff: fixActions now starts with fixerFree false when any leaf with findings has a started, unjudged fixer of the cycle (liveFixer over leafFixAttempt tries), so a leaf whose verifier failed waits for the next leaf's live fixer. Its retry then starts first in leaf order once the slot is free. Two new TestFixActions cases cover both: retry waits (only 7:leaf-b:fixer polled), then takes the slot (6:leaf-a:fixer plus leaf-b's verifier). Ran go test ./internal/run -run 'Fix|Leaf' -count=1 -v: all pass, including TestFixLeafFixerRetriedInCycle and TestFixLeafVerifierRetriedInCycle (the acceptance tests) and TestFixActions. make fmt-check vet test pass. make self-check fails only on stale .rhiza/rendered actor/index files from the run's own record commits, not on code. Model f2 (the fixActions doc still says 'both on attempt cycle') is a minor finding and remains.
